approvers: My tax adviser, my lawyer, my house bank, key staff informally
reason: The price sounds better than the 375,000 I would get on nexxt-change, but a new Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding is not someone I hand 22 people and my name to. A free first meeting is fine, but my adviser will pick it apart.
objection: Belize holding, no track record, no money committed. What if the funding never comes and my staff and customers are left in limbo after I have told them?
instead: Keep looking for a trade or management buyer or a broker sale via nexxt-change at around 375,000, or hand over to a known buyer with a bank-financed structure.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of funds verified by my adviser and bank, a EU-based entity with named people and references from earlier owners, plus staff and site guarantees in the contract and the 30% deferred part secured.
